title: ATTP Super League 2024
excerpt: A special format, maximum scale and the biggest prize fund! That’s the ATTP Super League.
body_html:
A special format, maximum scale and the biggest prize fund! That’s the ATTP Super League.


1 September marked the start of the first stage of the brand-new ATTP table tennis Super League in the Republic of Moldova, which will run until April 2025.


The long-awaited debut of the ATTP Super League was a success and incredibly exciting, and from the very first stage it was clear that all participants are fully focused and committed, and no one will give an inch.


Across every stage of the competition, each team must collect the maximum score, based on sets won, to advance to the Super League semi-final and then the final, where it will compete for the title of Moldova’s best table tennis team for the 2024-2025 season, ATTP edition.
